name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-reader
description: A living book library with voice reading. Drop an EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML, Markdown (or a whole folder) and MnemoReader extracts and vectorizes it into a Library vault, auto-detects chapters, and reads it aloud with word-synced karaoke highlighting using the Mnemosyne voice engine.

descriptionI18n.fr: Une bibliothèque de livres vivante avec lecture vocale. Déposez un EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML, Markdown (ou un dossier entier) et MnemoReader l'extrait et le vectorise dans un coffre Bibliothèque, détecte automatiquement les chapitres, et le lit à voix haute avec surlignage karaoké synchronisé mot à mot grâce au moteur vocal Mnemosyne.
descriptionI18n.en: A living book library with voice reading. Drop an EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML, Markdown (or a whole folder) and MnemoReader extracts and vectorizes it into a Library vault, auto-detects chapters, and reads it aloud with word-synced karaoke highlighting using the Mnemosyne voice engine.
descriptionI18n.es: Una biblioteca de libros viva con lectura por voz. Suelta un EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML, Markdown (o una carpeta entera) y MnemoReader lo extrae y vectoriza en una bóveda Biblioteca, detecta automáticamente los capítulos, y lo lee en voz alta con resaltado karaoke sincronizado palabra por palabra usando el motor de voz de Mnemosyne.

agentGuide: Name a book or a chapter the way the person says it (« Dune », « chapitre 3 », « le chapitre sur la baleine »): the reader finds it by its words, and an id still works. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.

To read aloud: play (with book to open it first, with chapter to start there); pause stops it where it is. play, goToChapter, goToPassage and goToPercent take book to open it first; skip and pause act on the book open.
A chapter by its number is given as digits (« 3 »). To move by one: goToChapter with move next, previous or restart.
To find a passage: goToPassage with a few of its words. Pages do not exist here: the text is read sentence by sentence, so use goToPercent for « the middle of the book ».
Faster, slower, the text size, the night / sepia / paper theme and the sleep timer: setReading. reading says where the reader is.

agentActions.summary: The books in the library: id, title, author, format, chapters, how far the person has read, import state, and which one is open.
agentActions.details: progressPercent is null for a book with no text yet, and 100 for a book marked finished (finished: true), as its card shows. import is idle, extracting, chaptering, vectorizing, archived or error (importError says why). inMemory = archived in the Library vault.

agentActions.summary: One book in full: its chapter titles, the chapter the person has reached, and how far they read.
agentActions.details: chapterTitles lists the first 200; chaptersNotShown counts the rest.

bookId.description: The book: its title or its author as the person says it (« Dune », « le livre de Herbert »), or its id.

agentActions.summary: Open a book in the reader, where the person left off, as a tap on its cover does.
agentActions.details: A book still importing is NOT_READY; a failed import is IMPORT_FAILED (the person retries it from the library).

bookId.description: The book: its title or its author as the person says it (« Dune », « le livre de Herbert »), or its id.

agentActions.summary: Close the reader and go back to the library, as the back arrow does.
Download a document (EPUB, PDF, DOCX, HTML...) from a link, import it into the library and archive it in the Library vault.
agentActions.details: Answers started at once: a download and its extraction can take minutes. Call books to follow it (import goes to archived, or error with importError). One import at a time (BUSY).

url.description: An http or https link to the document.

agentActions.summary: Where the open reader is: the book, the chapter, the sentence and the percent, whether it is reading aloud, the voice and the paces it takes, the sleep timer, and the reading settings.
agentActions.details: open is null on the library (the settings are still given).

agentActions.summary: Read aloud, as the play button does: from where the person left off, or from the start of a chapter.
agentActions.details: Resumes a pause. With book, opens it first. Already reading and a chapter given: goes there and keeps reading.

book.description: The book to open first: its title or author as the person says it, or its id. Absent = the book open.

chapter.description: The chapter: its number as digits (« 3 ») or words of its title, or its id.

agentActions.summary: Stop reading aloud where it is, as the pause button does; play resumes from there.
Go to a chapter, as a click in the chapter list does: a chapter named, or the next, the previous, or the start of this one.
agentActions.details: A reading going on keeps going from there. Give chapter or move, not both.

chapter.description: The chapter: its number as digits (« 3 ») or words of its title, or its id.

move.description: next, previous, or restart (the start of the chapter being read).

book.description: The book to open first: its title or author as the person says it, or its id. Absent = the book open.

agentActions.summary: Go to the sentence that holds a few words the person remembers.
agentActions.details: Several sentences holding them are refused with where they are: add words or the chapter.

words.description: A few words of the passage, as the person says them.

chapter.description: The chapter: its number as digits (« 3 ») or words of its title, or its id.

book.description: The book to open first: its title or author as the person says it, or its id. Absent = the book open.

agentActions.summary: Go to a point of the book by how far into it (50 = the middle), as a click on the progress bar does.

book.description: The book to open first: its title or author as the person says it, or its id. Absent = the book open.

agentActions.summary: Go forward or back by a few sentences in the book open, as the skip buttons do.

sentences.description: How many sentences: positive goes forward, negative goes back.

agentActions.summary: Change how the book is read: the pace, the text size, the theme, the sleep timer. Saved at once.
agentActions.details: speed faster / slower steps through the paces the voice takes, as the speed menu does; a voice with one pace is refused (NO_SPEED). sleepMinutes 0 turns the timer off.

text.description: larger or smaller, one step, as the A+ and A- chips.

fontSize.description: An exact text size in pixels.

sleepMinutes.description: Stop reading after this many minutes; 0 turns the timer off.
